definition_used: An error attributed to a journal/publisher.
caution: The definition is broad; the error could range from production mistakes to editorial process failures. Without specifics, it is not possible to determine if research content itself is affected, so research_content_reliability is not assigned. Attribution/authorship integrity is not directly indicated.
semantic_rationale: The definition attributes an error to the journal/publisher, which directly implicates editorial and production governance (editorial_peer_review_governance) and may involve post-publication transparency if the error leads to corrections or notices (post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight). The problem object is the article in general, as the error is not specified to data, images, etc. The process signal is journal_publisher_error, and the actor context is journal_publisher.
